note: Hand-authored gold set for T2/T3 slide retrieval eval over the 4 captioned gold decks. The index is multi-deck, so page numbers collide across decks: every qa_pair carries its own `source` (the deck filename) and `evidence_pages` are 1-indexed page numbers WITHIN that deck. A retrieved chunk counts as relevant only when BOTH its `source` matches the question's `source` AND its `page` is in `evidence_pages` (source-aware scoring is wired up in T3). `type: figure` marks questions whose answer is carried primarily by a slide diagram/figure rather than the on-slide prose; `type: text` marks prose/definition/equation questions. Pre-registered from slide ground truth before inspecting any retrieval output (PROPOSAL.md §8).
